offering_description.value: Delivers natural gas through its pipeline distribution systems to residential, commercial, industrial and transportation customers. Operates regulated local distribution utilities in Oklahoma, Kansas and Texas, earning regulated rates for delivery service.

primary_services.value: natural gas distribution; natural gas transportation; pipeline construction and maintenance; gas storage

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential households heating with natural gas; B2B: commercial and industrial businesses, transportation customers, power generators; B2G: public sector and government facilities

end_markets.value: residential heating; commercial buildings; industrial; energy utilities

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: regulated volumetric and customer charges for natural gas delivered to customers; service fees: transportation and storage service charges to transport customers
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs gas distribution pipelines purchased from suppliers, delivering to end-use customers

geography_served.value: US regional: Oklahoma, Kansas (Kansas Gas Service) and Texas (Texas Gas Service)

specialization.value: niche specialist: regulated natural gas distribution utilities in three states

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct service to customers through utility pipeline networks and meters

regulatory_exposure.value: high: rates and operations regulated by state commissions (Oklahoma, Kansas, Texas cities) and pipeline safety rules
